Title: Enterprise administrators can view reserved instances in the Azure portal

Body.Content:
As an Enterprise Agreement administrator, you can now see Azure reserved instances purchased in your enrollment by going to the Azure portal.

To view reservation transactions, go to Cost Management + Billing > Billing accounts. Reservation transaction history is available only to enterprise administrators (not available to department or account administrators).
